visual.altText: Lena holds an open blue envelope beside the library front desk; the small photograph rests on her palm. Daylight enters the street window.
Lena studies the photograph by the library side door; a red bench is visible in the courtyard beyond. Keep the writing on the photograph unreadable.
Lena stands inside the library side doorway with the envelope and photograph. An adult woman looks beneath the red courtyard bench. No baker is visible in this frame.
Inside the bakery doorway, Lena hands the blue envelope to the adult woman. The baker stands beside them. The photograph stays with the envelope; soft daylight lights the three adults.
Beside the courtyard red bench, Lena returns the blue envelope and photograph to the relieved woman. The library side door remains behind Lena; daylight is gentle.
